newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes sharply lower, market corrects.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes sharply lower, market corrects.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed sharply lower on Monday as the market corrected lower after last week's rally, with dealers clearing some positions before the September contract's expiry on Thursday.
"There was space for a correction and that's what we got," said one trader.
IPE Sept gas oil settled at $217.25 a tonne, off $2.50 from Friday's close. Oct Brent was off 15 cents at $22.39 per barrel at 1722 GMT.
"Gas oil was strong until NYMEX opened and then it lost heart," said another trader.
Dealers said there was less news about Iraq compared with last week and this had helped spreads and outrights ease.
"People digested last week's news over the weekend," said one trader.
The funds were seen rolling over their September positions into October.
But traders expected further volatility before Thursday. "The hike is not over yet, there will be more fun and games," said a trader.
